Subject: DPA execution & e-sign logistics for FinCloud / Redwood

Hi Logan,

Thanks for moving the DPA forward. Legal here — quick note on execution logistics so we can scope procurement and our legal checklist. We prefer DocuSign for traceability, but can accept AdobeSign if there are regional restrictions. Key constraints from our side: 

- Countersign must come from our VP Legal (Karen Li) after we sign.
- We need a separate envelope for the EU Data Transfer Addendum (EDTA) so our GDPR team can stamp it; the main DPA can be a second envelope.
- Please include a subprocessor appendix as a PDF attachment in the envelope (we'll confirm list).
- Provide DocuSign account ID or an envelope link so our procurement system can ingest the status.

Attached: FinCloud_DPA_Signoff_Instructions.pdf (instructions, required fields).

Can you share your signing order and the internal Redwood signer who will countersign on receipt? Also let us know if remote ID verification is required for EU signers — our compliance folks may ask for that.

Best,
Alex
Alex Smith
Contracts Manager | FinCloud
alex.smith@fincloud.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@fincloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-21T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA execution & e-sign logistics for FinCloud / Redwood

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (legal signatory team) and Dylan (legal ops) so we can coordinate envelopes and tech hookups. Quick plan from our side: 

1) Two-envelope flow (agree with your EDTA separation): envelope A = EDTA (EU signers), envelope B = main DPA + subprocessor appendix.
2) Primary platform: DocuSign. Fallback: AdobeSign if recipient tooling blocks DocuSign (we'll set that as a contingency).
3) Signing order (proposed): FinCloud Legal (Alex) -> FinCloud VP Legal (Karen Li) -> Redwood Legal reviewer (Dylan) -> Redwood countersignatory (Marissa Cole). Sequential routing to make countersignation traceable.
4) Signatory authority: Marissa Cole has countersign authority up to the value threshold in the attached signing_matrix_v1.csv. If the deal exceeds that threshold, we'll route to Marcus Lin (Finance) for countersign.
5) Verification: for EU personnel we'll enable remote ID verification. Please confirm whether FinCloud requires a specific ID vendor; otherwise we'll enable DocuSign ID Check.
6) Tech hooks: we'll enable DocuSign Connect webhooks to your ingestion URL and share envelope IDs once created. If you prefer your procurement to poll a single envelope link, we'll supply that too.

Attaching our redline of the DPA for transparency: RI_DPA_redline_20280821.pdf; signing matrix included.

Next steps for us: Dylan will draft the envelope roles and allowed signers. Marissa will confirm countersign authority. If that plan works for you, we'll create the two DocuSign envelopes and drop the links in this thread.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Logan / Marissa / Alex — drafting the envelope plan below (will add exact roles when I create envelopes):

Envelope A — EDTA (EU-only):
- Signing order: FinCloud Legal (Alex) -> FinCloud VP Legal (Karen Li) -> Redwood Legal reviewer (Dylan) -> Redwood witness (if required).
- Platform: DocuSign primary.
- Controls: Remote ID verification (DocuSign ID Check); Require signer to check a GDPR attest checkbox (custom field) before signing.
- Attachment: EDTA pdf (attached inside envelope).

Envelope B — Main DPA + Subprocessor Appendix:
- Signing order: FinCloud Legal (Alex) -> FinCloud Exec (if requested) -> Redwood Legal (Dylan) review step (optional) -> Redwood Countersignatory (Marissa Cole).
- Countersign delegation: If Marissa is unavailable, countersign allowed by Marcus Lin OR Marcus's delegate per signing_matrix_v1.csv. Delegates must be named on the envelope; please confirm Marcus as delegate if needed.
- Signature type: Authoritative signature (electronic signature with authentication).
- Audit: Include DocuSign Certificate of Completion; set email reminders 24h and 72h.
- Webhooks: we'll include your consumption endpoint (please confirm) and our internal webhook to update the deal record.

Exception handling / fallback:
- If DocuSign is blocked for EU signers, we'll create an AdobeSign envelope and manually reconcile the two envelope audit trails.
- If countersignature is delayed beyond 72 hours, we'll auto-escalate to Marcus Lin and the account exec.

Action items for Alex: please confirm
- your preferred ID verification vendor (or OK to use DocuSign ID Check),
- the procurement envelope ingestion method (DocuSign account ID vs. direct envelope link), and
- whether FinCloud requires a wet-signature exception for any listed execs.

I'll craft envelopes after confirmation and paste links here.

—Dylan

- ID verification: OK to use DocuSign ID Check.
- Procurement ingestion: we prefer envelope link + DocuSign account ID (our system can ingest either). DocuSign account ID: 12-345-6789.
- Wet-sign: none required. Karen will countersign after she receives the envelope and expects countersign within 48 hours.

Please proceed with creating Envelope A and B. Once you generate the envelopes please paste both envelope links and the envelope IDs here; we'll monitor from our side and provide countersign promptly.
